keywords: 待办 todo 记一下 要做的事 等定 备忘 长期 清单 やること to-do list
db_setup: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT, who TEXT, created TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')), done_at TEXT)

add.summary: Add one to-do: something that must be done later or is waiting on the person's decision — not a step of the job in hand. who = your name.
add.sql: INSERT INTO items (title, note, who) VALUES (?, ?, ?)

list.summary: List the open to-dos (id, title, note, who, created).
list.sql: SELECT id, title, note, who, created FROM items WHERE done_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

done.summary: Mark a to-do done by id.
done.sql: UPDATE items SET done_at = datetime('now','localtime') WHERE id = ? AND done_at IS NULL

remove.summary: Delete a to-do (the person's button only).

handle.summary: Hand one to-do to the persona to work on now.

css: body{margin:0}.wrap{padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--panel);color:var(--text)}.add{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px}.add button{padding:4px 12px}.add input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:4px 8px}.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:3px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.tt{flex:1;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.who{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}.row button{flex:0 0 auto;padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line)}.row button.go{background:var(--brand);color:var(--text);border-color:var(--brand)}.row button.armed{background:var(--danger);color:var(--text);border-color:var(--danger)}.empty{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;padding:4px 0}
